dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular, jagged-edged 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with a sharp gradient transition from a dark charcoal exterior to a light cream interior; most concentrated in the upper-right and mid-dorsal regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, localized light-intensity clusters interspersed within the annuli field; notable concentration of a large, solid high-intensity mass in the lower-central region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: An asymmetrical triangular relationship formed by three prominent annuli centroids in the upper-right quadrant, oriented toward a larger focal annulus in the mid-right field.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, continuous hook-shaped light-colored region in the lower-left to central quadrant that lacks the internal-external gradient characteristic of the surrounding annuli.
